definitions.explanation: A person who is wounded or ill, especially one needing medical attention in an emergency, disaster, or first-aid situation.

examples.japanese: {傷病者|しょうびょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: To carry the injured to the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{傷病者|しょうびょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手当|てあ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To treat the injured at the scene of the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{傷病者|しょうびょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{救護|きゅうご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最優先|さいゆうせん}→最優先：13012_saiyuusen⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In a disaster, care for the injured and sick is given top priority.

notes:
Composed of {傷|しょう} (wound) + {病|びょう} (illness) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Covers both the injured and the sick with one word, so it is common in first-aid, emergency-services, and disaster-response contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傷病者|しょうびょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧: transport of the injured and sick
- {傷病者|しょうびょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{救護|きゅうご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give first aid to casualties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}→負傷者：27169_fushousha⟧: injured person — wounds only, not illness
- ⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧: disaster victim — affected by a disaster, not necessarily hurt
